**[Dan Murphy](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/dan-murphy) was elected as Connétable of Grouville in 2003**.

|  | Name | Party | Votes |  |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | **[Dan Murphy](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/dan-murphy)** |  | 851 | 62.5% |
| 2 | [Bruce Willing](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/bruce-willing) |  | 505 | 37.1% |
| 3 | ~~[John Lamy](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/john-lamy)~~ |  | Withdrew |  |

2,892 registered voters

47.1% turnout
